title: Among all molecules that contain at least one sulfur atom bonded to another
question: Among all molecules that contain at least one sulfur atom bonded to another atom, which molecule has the highest number of double bonds, and is it carcinogenic?

prediction.sql:
SELECT m."XCL_011"
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m."XCL_010" = (
  SELECT m2."XCL_010"
  FROM molecule AS m2
  WHERE m2."XCL_010" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a."XCL_003" = 's'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connected AS c WHERE c."XCL_007" = a."XCL_001")
  )
  GROUP BY m2."XCL_010"
  ORDER BY (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond AS b WHERE b."XCL_005" = m2."XCL_010" AND b."XCL_006" = '='
  ) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.XCL_010 = a.XCL_002
JOIN connected c1 ON a.XCL_001 = c1.XCL_007
JOIN atom a2 ON c1.XCL_008 = a2.XCL_001
JOIN bond b ON c1.XCL_009 = b.XCL_004
WHERE a.XCL_003 = 'S'
GROUP BY m.XCL_010
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN b.XCL_006 = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC
LIMIT 1

react.raw_react_sql:
SELECT m."XCL_011"
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE m."XCL_010" = (
  SELECT m2."XCL_010"
  FROM molecule AS m2
  WHERE m2."XCL_010" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM atom AS a
    WHERE a."XCL_003" = 's'
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connected AS c WHERE c."XCL_007" = a."XCL_001")
  )
  GROUP BY m2."XCL_010"
  ORDER BY (
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond AS b WHERE b."XCL_005" = m2."XCL_010" AND b."XCL_006" = '='
  ) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
